name: DROWL Layouts
description: Provides ZURB Foundation-based layouts for Layout Builder / Layout Discovery.
project_description:
Provides DROWL 's default ZURB Foundation layout builder layouts. Shared with the community for other ZURB Foundation Drupal users.

 Important: Because Foundation is basically dead, we switched over to Bootstrap. So the successor of this module is DROWL Layouts BS .

 This module is heavily based on the core issue [#2904550] which breaks config import / export when using custom layouts in theme because the theme is handled like a (missing) module. So you will need the patch applied until this is FIXED.

 Back to top 

 Versions 
 4.x: 
 
 Uses layout_paragraphs (assuming layout_paragraphs:^2 from 4.2 on) 
 Foundation XY-Grid classes 
 Drupal ^8.8 / 9 Support 
 
 3.x : 
 Skipped. Using 4.x to be equal to other compatible drowl_* modules.

 8.x-2.x : 
 
 Written with & for layout_builder (& entity_reference_layouts) in mind. 
 Drupal ^8.8 / 9 Support 
 No further development 
 
 8.x-1.x : 
 
 Before layout_builder! 
 NO Drupal ^8.8 / 9 Support 
 
 The default templates files are written for Zurb Foundation, but all classes are set inside the template files. So you can modify this easily for Bootstrap or whatever you like.

 Various layout options available, like:

 
 Column width (equal to core layouts) - some width variants for the coloumns 
 Horizontal & vertical alignment of columns (Foundations .align-X classes) 
 Section width (Viewport width, Page width, ...) 
 Collapsing grid gutter per device size 
 Extra classes 
 
 Theme the entity reference layout widget 
 You can simply add a library to your custom theme called:

 
 2.x - 3.x: "YOURTHEME/drowl_layouts_erl_additions" 
 4.x: "YOURTHEME/drowl_layouts_layout_paragraphs_additions" 
 
 DROWL Layouts module will search for this library in the current default theme and attach it. This way you are able to add CSS & JS files to improve the ERL widget and archive more realistic preview styles for your paragraphs.
